attributes.board_name: Wyoming Mental Health Professions Licensing Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE with significant intellectual or practical content aimed at competence in the licensed discipline (Board Rules Chapter 14); business-related training such as BLS, drugs in the workplace or HIPAA does not count.
rules.audit_note: Non-audited renewals attest to the hours (form updated 18 Feb 2026); licensees selected for audit submit a CE course list and certificates.
rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Mental Health Professions Licensing Board Rules, Chapter 14, Sections 3 and 4
rules.notes: Licenses expire on the holder's birth date every two years; paper renewal must be postmarked by the expiration date; no late renewal. Fingerprints with renewal every four years.
